candidates.title: Survey of Palestine, Bethlehem 01-beit-jala (FL10423295 2369494)
candidates.cite: by Survey of Palestine; Public domain; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Survey_of_Palestine,_Bethlehem_01-beit-jala_(FL10423295_2369494).jpg
candidates.why: 306a audit 2026-10-12: wrong place (toponymic collision) - this is a British Survey of Palestine ground sheet (sheet 01 of the Bethlehem/Beit Jala area of Judaea), but the site bethlehem-q2523914 is the Dutch hamlet Bethlehem in Het Hogeland, Groningen (Wikidata Q2523914). The sheet frame and its Beit Jala hamlet/field hatching land on the polder only by local parcel-grid coincidence (the small residuals measure that pattern match, not the truth). Removed from the map; the doc record is kept here.
